name: Glass theme, dark mode, over a window, from opening the panel to picking an app

media.caption: The Glass theme uses the system's most translucent glass. The window behind the panel stays sharp.
media.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in the Glass theme, dark mode. Slick's settings window, open on its About page, sits over a purple gradient wallpaper behind the panel. The theme's glass has no tint and no frost, so the app icon, the name and the lines of the About page stay sharp through it, and the panel's own text carries a soft dark halo. The panel opens with Music, Notes, Mail and Calendar suggested. Typing “c”, “a” and “l” narrows the results. With “cal” the list shows Calendar, Calculator, Calculator History, Quit All Applications, Eject All Disks, Search Apple Maps and Create Quicklink. The selection moves down to Calculator. Command-K opens the action panel, a card of regular glass with a deeper tint, and closes it again. Return picks Calculator and the panel closes. The scenario notes the launch instead of opening the app. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, with Apple's own apps and their real icons.
